shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
He enjoys cooking new recipes on weekends.
They went hiking in the mountains last summer.
We should try that new Italian restaurant downtown.
She often listens to music while studying for exams.
My friends and I regularly play games online together.
Traveling to new places always brings me joy and excitement.
Learning a new language can be challenging yet rewarding.
Participating in community events helps build great connections.
Volunteering at the local shelter has changed my perspective on life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you have had?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of travel on personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What are some of your favorite meals to prepare at home?
Q2: Have you ever struggled with maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is nutrition in our daily lives?
Q4: What tips would you give someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise and fitness.
questions: Q1: What types of physical activities do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in your fitness journey?
Q3: Why do you think regular exercise is important for health?
Q4: What recommendations would you make for someone starting a workout routine?
